events.UNLIT_FIRE.title: 还没烧起来的火
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.description:
木柴还没点着，灰烬却是热的。旁边的沙漏里，沙子正往上落。

一块木牌写着：[gold]“昨日开放。”[/gold]

你伸出手。远处某个火堆的温度，提前到了这里。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.REST.de: 立即休息，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]生命。你下一处休息点[red]无法行动[/red]。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.REST_LO: 无法休息、没有前方火堆，或已有余烬约定。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.SMITH.d: 立即[green]锻造[/green]。你下一处休息点[red]无法行动[/red]。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.SMITH_L: 无法锻造、没有前方火堆，或已有余烬约定。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.FUEL.de: 支付[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。到达下一处休息点时额外回复[green]{BonusHeal}[/green]生命。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.FUEL_LO: 需要[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]、前方火堆，且尚未立下约定。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.REST.description:
你在冰冷的木柴旁坐下，却暖和得很快睡着了。

醒来时，沙漏已经空了。

你隐约记得，下一次经过这里时自己会觉得冷。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.SMITH.description:
火没有烧起来，牌的边缘却亮了。

你收好它。远处传来一声很轻的噗响，像有人吹灭了火。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.FUEL.description:
你把金币压在木牌下，抱来一捆干柴。

沙漏中的沙子终于开始向下落了。

有一处火堆正在等你，烧得比刚才暖些。
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.CHARCOAL.description:
灰烬底下露出了几枚[gold]金币[/gold]。你掸掉灰，收进了口袋。

看来已经有人付过账了。

relics.BORROWED_EMBER.title: 余烬约定
relics.BORROWED_EMBER.debtTerms: 你下一处休息点无法执行休息点行动。
relics.BORROWED_EMBER.kindledTerms: 到达下一处休息点时，额外回复[green]{Heal}[/green]生命。
relics.BORROWED_EMBER.flavor: 有些火，已经替你烧过了。

rest_site_ui.OPTION_THINGS_SPENT_EMBER.name: 余烬已尽
rest_site_ui.OPTION_THINGS_SPENT_EMBER.description: 这处火堆的机会已经提前用掉了。收拾行囊，继续前进。

events.UNLIT_FIRE.title: The Unlit Fire
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.description:
The logs have not caught, but the ashes are warm. Sand climbs upward through an hourglass.

A wooden sign reads: [gold]“Open yesterday.”[/gold]

You hold out a hand. Warmth from a fire farther ahead has arrived early.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.REST.de: Rest now. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next Rest Site.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.REST_LO: Rest unavailable, no camp ahead, or you already have an Ember Pact.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.SMITH.d: [green]Smith[/green] now. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next Rest Site.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.SMITH_L: Smith unavailable, no camp ahead, or you already have an Ember Pact.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.FUEL.de: Pay [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Heal an extra [green]{BonusHeal}[/green] HP on arrival at your next Rest Site.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.FUEL_LO: Requires [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], a camp ahead, and no existing pact.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.REST.description:
You sit beside the cold logs and soon fall asleep in their warmth.

When you wake, the hourglass is empty.

You dimly remember feeling cold the next time you came here.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.SMITH.description:
The fire never catches, but the edges of your card glow.

You put it away. Far off, something softly goes out.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.FUEL.description:
You tuck the coins beneath the sign and bring over a bundle of dry wood.

The sand finally begins to fall downward.

Somewhere ahead, a warmer fire waits for you.
events.UNLIT_FIRE.pages.CHARCOAL.description:
[gold]Coins[/gold] glint beneath the ashes. You brush them clean and pocket them.

Apparently, someone has already paid.

relics.BORROWED_EMBER.title: Ember Pact
relics.BORROWED_EMBER.debtTerms: You cannot use Rest Site actions at your next Rest Site.
relics.BORROWED_EMBER.kindledTerms: Heal an extra [green]{Heal}[/green] HP on arrival at your next Rest Site.
relics.BORROWED_EMBER.flavor: Some fires have already burned for you.

rest_site_ui.OPTION_THINGS_SPENT_EMBER.name: Spent Embers
rest_site_ui.OPTION_THINGS_SPENT_EMBER.description: You already used this fire's opportunity. Pack up and continue.
